notes: *every one* for אִישׁ could be headed on *every* as a quantifier; rule 31's subtraction puts the head on *one*, which carries the lexeme, and rule 15 keeps the supplied determiner off the head.
שֹׁפְטֵי is an anarthrous substantival participle in construct, so its supplied *the* joins its own unit under rules 29 and 46, headed on *judges*.
